headline: Macron plans to reform the Constitution to curb spending in France
summary: French President Emmanuel Macron is considering adding a "golden rule" to the constitution to reduce public debt. The proposal aims to restrain government spending in France.
why: Fiscal rules constrain how much a government can borrow and spend, which shapes French government bond supply and debt sustainability assessments.
original_headline: Macron planea reformar la Constitución para frenar el gasto en Francia
